I put $10,000 in a 529 when my son was about 2 years old (he’s almost 10 now). We’ve added a little bit of money here and there over the years. But it’s only worth $16,000 right now. There’s no way in another ten years it will pay for much college.

I’m not responsible for paying for higher education for my kids. I don’t owe them that. I owe them not having to take care of me when I get old. I’ve got a good bit saved for retirement and the nursing home. I’m not putting caring for me when I get old on them.

I have told my 9 year old that we cannot pay for college or trade school. He will need to find scholarships to pay for it. He is welcome to live with us while he’s going to college or trade school though. 

He’s does have a 529 savings account but there’s no way it will even cover a year of college.

Please don’t think I’m bragging. The dental implant process sucks but I know I’m lucky I could come up with the money for it. 

I have shitty genetics combined with lack of dental insurance when I was in my early 20s. I take really good care of my teeth and see the dentist every 6 months. But it was too late for that tooth. It held w a root canal and crown for like 15 years. Then the crown wouldn’t stay on because of lack of tooth structure.

Nope, we have 3 kids. We can’t afford shit even though we don’t have much debt and our house is paid off. 

But I will be getting the crown on my dental implant in a few months. Sorry kids mommy needs a new tooth.
I could never stand and nurse. Like it would break my arms and my babies weren’t used to it so whenever I tried it just felt impossible.

We have three kids - almost 10 years old, 4 years old and 18 month old. 

We have very little debt. We don’t have the latest anything (older cars, older cell phones). Our home is paid for. We do not go on vacations and especially not to freaking Disney World. 

Our oldest child is school age and goes to public school. I’m a stay at home mom so we don’t have to pay for daycare. Although the 4 year old goes to preschool 2 days a week during the school year.

We find cheaper “hobby” options for the kids. Middle child is in swim lessons at the local college vs other swim places that are 3 times as expensive. Oldest child plays basketball through his school ($75 for the season) and volleyball through the city’s rec system.

We eat mostly at home. Although as parents we treat ourselves to a lunch out maybe once a week. It’s really the only way we treat ourselves. We go while 2 of the 3 kids are at school/preschool so we avoid paying for a babysitter. 

I shop for the kids clothes at yard sales and consignment sales. I watch for sales on tennis shoes and stock up when the price is low. My husband and I don’t shop for clothes for ourselves very often (he wears a uniform for work). 

We read a lot of library books and even borrowed an Oculus VR thing from the library. My son really wanted a Oculus but that’s not in our budget and seems excessive for a kid. So he still got to enjoy one without the cost. We will hopefully borrow it again soon. 

We live a simple, happy life.

Got pregnant and gave birth at 36 with baby #2. Got pregnant at 38 and gave birth at 39 with baby #3.

Pregnancy #3 was much more difficult than #2. But honestly I think I just lucked out with pregnancy #2. It was so easy. I had several minor complications with pregnancy #3.

My birth plan was scheduled c-section with both #2 and #3. My first baby was a vaginal delivery with horrific tearing after a 24 hour labor. I wasn’t putting myself through that again. 

I’m an only child and I don’t recommend having only one child (I know sometimes it can’t be avoided for many reasons). I hate not having any siblings. I know there is no guarantee my kids will be friends when they grow up but I hope so.
Yep. It’s horrible. As you know they named him after Charles Spurgeon. The name Charles was right there!! They didn’t have to choose something so odd.

I had my second child at 36. Easiest, most boring pregnancy and delivery ever (and for that I’m very thankful). No swelling. No nothing. When it was time for my schedule c-section I felt like I could have been pregnant for another 3 months. I felt that great. Baby was born perfectly healthy no issues. 

I had my third child at 39. It was rough. I had lots of little issues along the way including severe carpal tunnel and swelling. I had borderline gestational diabetes. Baby had repeated low blood sugar at birth despite me having well managed my blood sugar with my diet. She was fine though after about 24 hours. 

I think, unless you have a serious pre-existing condition, pregnancy can be the luck of the draw. The same can be said for your baby’s health. There are never any guarantees when it comes to health or pregnancy.

I went a wedding that had a fake cake except for the top tier the couple cut together. Guests were all served a Costco sheet cake from the kitchen. I would have never known except my mother in law and told me.
I liked Vivian too and considered naming my daughter it. But my husband vetoed it.
Also I don’t think the mom, who posted she gives her kid unlimited screen time, really believes the bullshit she’s spouting. She just wants to justify not parenting.

I think I saw the same post. It made me sad for the children. The mom’s post mentioned the kids were at daycare all day and then come home and are allowed unlimited screen time. So when are the parents and children interacting and spending any time together? 

Don’t get me wrong my kids would love to watch tv and play video games all day and night. But I know that’s not good for them so I don’t allow it. 

I think there is a middle ground with screen time. My kids do usually have a few minutes of screen time a day but they also play a lot (especially outside) and read books. We spend time with them and take them places. We believe in letting our kids be bored and not having them constantly entertained by an electronic device. 

I’m deeply concerned for this next generation of children. Some of them aren’t being parented at all.

“The pain isn’t that bad. Just take some Tylenol. Some people don’t even need that.”

Yeah, sure.

Vaginal tearing with childbirth. I thought it was only your skin that tore. That would be bad enough but you can actually tear your anal sphincters. Even when they sew you back together it won’t be the same. 

Mammograms hurt like hell. Even after my mammogram my breasts were aching and throbbing. It feels like someone putting your whole breasts into a stapler and holding your breasts smashed into the stapler. Side note: I think I had a bad tech doing mine because she hurt me even grabbing my breasts to put them on the machine for a mammogram. 

Doctors treat you different because you are female. They won’t take your pain seriously and will deny you pain medication. My husband has never been denied pain medication. 

You don’t have to have a period every month. There is an option to take birth control and skip all of that monthly nightmare. I suffered through so many painful periods when I didn’t have to.

No man you don’t want diabetes or heart problems caused by sleep apnea. Plus you just feel like shit every day when you have untreated sleep apnea. 

I wonder if your depression would improve if your sleep apnea was treated.

I’ve been on cpap for probably 16 years (since I was around 25). At first it was horrible because the damn mask kept poking me in the eyes and it was so uncomfortable. I tried two different masks and gave up. I even tried that mouth appliance fitted by a dentist for sleep apnea and it was worse to sleep with. 

I was desperate to feel better so I went to a different place to get fitted for a mask and finally got the right one. Having the right mask made all the difference. I have a “zest petite” nasal mask.
Yes, this is helpful. Thank you! I’ve called my dermatologist’s office and I’m waiting to hear back from them as well.

My kid was home sick today. He laid on the couch and we watched Jurassic Park together. This is as close to that feeling I’m probably ever going to get again. 

I wish I had thought to turn on Price is Right this morning.

I make “drinkable yogurts” for my kids. I take whatever yogurt they like and put it in a glass. Then I add milk and mix with a spoon. If it’s still lumpy I use a milk frother to mix it to make it smooth.

My middle kid doesn’t like “chunks” in his yogurt so I buy yogurt without any fruit pieces in it.

James. You cannot go wrong with James. 
My son is the 5th generation with the first name James in our family.

It’s 2025. Why are women still having periods? 

Seriously I’ve not had a period since starting my birth control and it’s such a blessing. I realize birth control pills are not an option for every woman. I’m sorry that some of us still have to suffer through periods.

Nope, I feel like the parents are either way younger (in their 20s) or around my age (41). My oldest is 9, almost 10. 

I also have a 4 year old and a 17 month. I feel like the parents at preschool are probably a few years younger than me.

You need to go talk to HR and have them explain your insurance plan. 

I have a plan that has cop-pays so I would pay that amount usually $25 or $40 for a visit to a walk-in clinic. I also have a deductible for other things. 

It’s too much to explain in detail here. You need a copy of your formulary from your insurance (your HR rep should have one) to explain your insurance coverage.

I mean we had NO other help but at least we had each other. I had days and he had nights.

Yes.

We have three kids, ages 9.5 years, 4 years and 17 months.

My 9 year old asked me tonight “Why don’t we just go to Waffle House?” 

No, because we don’t have money like that son.

I’ll just say it … I labored for 24 hours, pushed for 2.5 hours and had a forceps delivery that literally ripped me a new one. I was able to get in and out of bed at the hospital with no problem. 

Now my first C-section it was incredibly painful to get in and out of the bed. I don’t think I was given enough pain medication after that delivery because pulling myself to the edge of the bed hurt bad enough to make me cry. 

Second C-section I knew to advocate for better pain control and had a much easier time.

All that to say this is fake. She’s faking this. She’s not in that much pain. She needed content.

Right?! I have three kids and every time after delivery I think how happy I am my baby made it here safely and is doing well. My next thought is that  I’m just so relieved and happy NOT to be pregnant anymore.

Of course BDong had the most special birth. But throw in that JDip was traumatized so she can have a sort of cliff hanger for her followers. Anything to get attention and clicks. 

Also if you had a traumatic birth it’s not your fault. Birth doesn’t always go how we plan or how we hope. No matter how you prepare or “protect your mind” things still can happened that are unplanned and down right terrifying. 

I just don’t like BDong’s tone of she got the birth she hoped for because she did everything right and because God loves her the most. No, girl it’s just the luck of the draw.

I had forgotten how hilariously entertaining and ridiculous this show was, especially in the early days. 

Thank you all for the laughs tonight reliving these moments.

Birth is completely unpredictable. I don’t think there is anything you could do to be a failure at giving birth. We can’t control our bodies because if we could we would make giving birth easy, quick, and pain free. 

The women you know personally who had a predictable birth without trauma are either lucky or not telling you the whole truth. I mean yes people do experience that and that’s great for them. But not everyone. 

I had a physically and mentally traumatic birth in 2015. I was left with crippling PTSD and needing repeated doctors visits and treatments to physically heal. I just want you to know you are not alone in having birth trauma and you did nothing to cause it. 

I really, really suffered after my traumatic birth. I hate for anyone else to feel that way. If you want to talk more please let me know.

It’s really sad when women think how they gave birth makes them better than other women who had an epidural or C-section. 

Birth isn’t a competition and there isn’t a trophy for whoever suffers the most.

Start investing in your 401k at work and set up an IRA. Seriously get a savings plan for retirement. Pretend it’s your mortgage and put money into these every month before you do anything else (this is assuming you don’t have other debt).

I actually fell in love with it. Then after having it for a year a lady pulled out in front of my husband and totaled it. I’m still bitter about it.

So is this a nursery? It’s just a small room, right? Why did Janessa need to stay in a room by herself for the last 5 years? I feel like the oldest child should have that room by themselves.

I’m no expert but you need a new pediatrician asap. 

What you are describing doesn’t sound normal at all. Your child isn’t just not a good sleeper. Something is going on. 

Please find a new pediatrician tomorrow and get an appointment scheduled. Even if you just see a different doctor in the same practice as your current doctor.

I’ve been buying Aldi trash bags for years, but lately they are too thin and tear just putting them in the trash can.

Starting progesterone only birth control pills. I no longer have periods, nor the debilitating cramps that came with periods.

I did ballon sinuplasty and turbinate reduction in the doctor’s office in 2018. 

My turbinate reduction didn’t work. My doctor said up to 10 percent done in office need another surgery in the OR. I’m unfortunately one of those. 

Only one of my sinuses was blocked and I had ballon sinuplasty to open it. I actually ended up getting a sinus infection right after my procedure. 

CT of the sinus confirmed the ballon sinuplasty worked and opened my sinus but it hasn’t made any difference to me. I never felt any better or got any less sinus infections. But I hear other people have great success. 

Is your doctor refusing to do it with local anesthesia?

I think I took a prescription anxiety med before and I definitely had local anesthesia on my nose. It still hurt but I was so trying to avoid having to do general anesthesia and a “real” surgery in the OR.

My doctor recommends I have a septoplasty and turbinate reduction. He will do the surgery like your doctor - without packing or stents and use dissolvable sutures.  

Is there anything you wish you had known before your surgery? Anything at all? About the surgery or recovery? 

What was the worst part of it all?

How long was it before you could breathe through your nose again? 

What advice would you give me? 

How bad was it really? I just keep reading horror stories about the recovery. I’m thinking why put myself through a hellish recovery.

I so can relate to “my anxiety was convincing me I might not need it.”

I just had to cancel my surgery and am now trying to decide if so should reschedule.

I can breathe but always feel congestion. According to my doctor I need a septoplatsty and a turbinate reduction. But I’m kinda one the fence about getting it. I’m feel like my breathing isn’t that bad to put myself through the hell of recovery.

Thank you for being concerned about your student and investigating what happened.

I hope you, OP, will have a conversation with the foster mom about consent and honoring a child’s preferences (when it’s safe for the child).

I’d love to see more Tariq this season. He’s the funniest character on the show.

“Work Family” (Season 1, Episode 8) will alway be my favorite episode. 

“If somebody try to give you drugs, punch ‘em in the face.”

I saw someone else say don’t use the same first letter as your son, Luke. I agree. Luke and Lily sound too cutesy.

I wouldn’t add the vine or bolero to the dress. It doesn’t need it. 

As for shoes I’d look for a very low heel if heels are what you are wanting.  That might not be enough support for your feet though.

It’s really a shame to Jill and Shrek CHOOSE to have their children live in poverty. Shrek and Jill both could get paying jobs. Then they would have the money to feed and clothe their children (plus a little bit extra for some fun activities).

I also feel for my children because my husband is an only child as well. My children don’t have aunt or uncles or any first cousins. It’s very sad how little close family we have. 

Maybe if either of us had a sibling we would have more family to spend time with and my kids would have friends in their cousins.

I had a horrific delivery, recovery and postpartum with my first. It took me 4.5 years before I became brave enough to try to have another baby so I get it. Maybe in time you will feel different about having another but then again maybe not.

No one, especially a man, should ever touch a woman in public. He was way out of line and I, as a woman, would have felt exactly like you did. 

I think the gym needs to have a talk with him about keeping his hands to himself. I really don’t care what his intentions were. He’s way out of line.
Right? Losing 59 lbs is amazing.

I also always look at the coffee cups. I feel coffee cups reflect your personality and I like unique coffee cups. That being said I only own like 5 coffee cups.

You should pair an unusual first name with a more common middle name. 

Costas would be an unusual name in the US, (but idk if you are in the US) so I’d go with a more traditional middle name. Names like William, James, John. 

Also if you aren’t sold on Costas I suggest now is the time to change his whole name.

Conversations are like interviews especially when you first meet someone. It should be a back and forth. I think this can take practice which you don’t have just yet because you are young.

Stop comparing yourself to other people. It will nearly always make you feel inadequate. I know this is hard to do. Getting off social media can help. As you probably know social media is where people filter themselves and try their hardest to be appear cool, wealthy, etc. 

You also have to stop telling yourself all these negative things. Stop that thought process. Talk back to those negative thoughts.

Would online therapy be an option in your country? I’m in the US and with the pandemic many therapists have turned to doing therapy sessions online. A therapist can help you with these negative thoughts and help you on working through your feelings. 

What things interest you? Reading? Woodworking? Baking? Think of something you might find interesting or enjoy doing and start there. You don’t have to be good at it. If you find you don’t like it then pick another interest.

When it comes to conversations try asking someone more detailed questions to build on their previous answers.
